name: application-audit-trail-row
title: Audit Trail Row
description: Compliance-oriented log list showing actor, action, target, an optional before/after change, and a timestamp, driven by a typed entries prop contract.
useWhen: Compliance or security tooling needs to show who did what, to what, and when, for accountability.
Some actions have a specific before/after value change worth showing inline (e.g. plan changed from Starter to Pro).
Destructive actions (e.g. removing an API key) should be visually distinguished from routine changes.
avoidWhen: The log is about system/analytics events rather than human actor actions — use the Event Log Table instead, which is built for structured payloads rather than actor-centric sentences.
No before/after value is relevant — a simpler Activity Feed communicates plain actions without the diff affordance.
You need full JSON payload inspection — pair this with the JSON Tree Viewer for detailed forensic review.
responsiveBehavior: Each entry is a full-width row with the actor avatar, sentence, and optional diff on the left and the timestamp right-aligned; long actor sentences wrap naturally within the row.
accessibility: Each entry reads as a natural-language sentence ('Actor action target') so screen readers convey the full audit context without relying on visual layout.
The before/after diff pairs strikethrough styling with red color for the removed value and a plain green tint for the new value, not color alone.
Destructive-action avatars use both a red background and remain part of the same sentence structure, so severity isn't conveyed by color alone.

variants.title: Audit Trail Row
variants.description: Actor-avatar log list with natural-language action sentences, an inline before/after value diff, a monospace note for identifier-style changes, and timestamps.
accessibility: Removed values use strikethrough in addition to red color; the full sentence structure carries meaning without relying on the diff colors alone.

variants.title: Audit Trail Row (Dark)
variants.description: Audit trail list adapted for dark surfaces with the same actor-avatar, sentence, and before/after diff structure.
accessibility: Actor avatar colors, diff chip colors, and timestamp text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
